dedup_outcomes.why_this_matters: The two rules give different answers to the top-up question. Under the governing exact-span rule the benchmark clears 100 with margin. Under chunk-level grouping it falls short, because a chunk is the unit a retrieval system is actually scored on. This is the decision the coordinator now has to make, and it was not resolvable before all 150 were adjudicated.

rule: Eligible pool = SUPPORTED minus cases dropped by COLLISION-RULINGS-001.
Quota 20 per slice; a slice with fewer than 20 eligible contributes all of them and the shortfall is reallocated to the slice with the largest remaining surplus.
Within a slice, greedily take the case whose gold chunk set overlaps least with chunks already accepted; ties by case ID ascending.
No retrieval or reranking system consulted. Chunk membership read from the frozen chunk table.
